data.title: Learning to let go
data.description: <p>Parking a pickup by the roadside, an old man, a girl and a black dog catch sight of bats flying across the sky until the last light goes out. Like a camera, Regretfully At Dawn captures this ephemeral moment between the vanishing present and the emerging future and the process of letting go in such a tender, yet powerful way when a new season of life comes around.</p>
